instruction: Cinematic film still, full shot, eye-level profile view. In an indoor yoga studio with wooden flooring and draped cream curtains, two people perform partner yoga on a black mat. On the left, the shirtless bald man with a black bandana (R2) wears black track pants with white stripes, facing right. On the right, the woman with pink braided hair (R1) wears a black sports bra and black leggings, facing left. They are both balanced in a V-shaped seated pose, their feet pressed sole-to-sole high in the air. They hold each other's wrists with arms extended straight between their legs, maintaining a focused, neutral expression. The scene is illuminated by warm, soft side lighting, creating a calm, earthy atmosphere.
